title: Mario Kart: Double Dash!!
shortDescription: A team-oriented kart racer that gives every race a playful layer of coordination through paired drivers and item swapping.
highlights: Two-character teams create meaningful cooperation in local play
Distinct character items keep races readable and mischievous

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A focused GameCube multiplayer pick whose paired-driver rule gives the familiar kart formula a clear platform-specific identity.
